derivation: from G4314 (πρός) and a form of (to be vexed with something irksome);

occurrences.text: Wherefore I was grieved with that generation, and said, They do alway err in their heart; and they have not known my ways.
But with whom was he grieved forty years? was it not with them that had sinned, whose carcases fell in the wilderness?
